☢️ PhD Opportunity: Glycoengineered Peptides and Nanobodies for Imaging and Therapy — ETH Zurich

📍 Location: Zurich, Switzerland 🇨🇭
🏛️ Department: Center for Radiopharmaceutical Sciences (CRS) — joint ETH Zurich/PSI center
👨‍🔬 Supervisor: Prof. Roger Schibli (co-collaboration with Prof. Kaspar Locher, Department of Biology, ETH Zurich)

🧬 About the Project
Peptides and nanobodies hold huge promise for molecular imaging and targeted cancer therapy — but their clinical use is often limited by rapid blood clearance and high kidney uptake. This PhD project investigates how defined N-glycosylation can improve the pharmacokinetic properties of these biomolecules. Novel glycoengineered peptides and nanobodies, generated in the Locher lab, will be radiolabeled and systematically evaluated in the Schibli lab using advanced in vitro and in vivo methods — combining glycobiology, radiopharmaceutical chemistry, and targeted radionuclide therapy in a truly interdisciplinary, bench-to-bedside project.

🧑‍🔬 Ideal Candidate
- Master's degree with excellent academic record in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or related field
- Strong interest in radiopharmaceutical sciences, molecular imaging, protein engineering, glycobiology, or bioconjugation chemistry
- Practical experience in radiochemistry/radiopharmacy, cell biology, protein/peptide chemistry, or preclinical in vivo research
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
- Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in an international, interdisciplinary team
- Excellent written and spoken English
- Bonus: prior experience with radiopharmaceutical research, PET/SPECT imaging, or animal studies

✨ Why Apply
- Work at the forefront of a true bench-to-bedside radiopharmaceutical research field
- Join CRS, an internationally recognized joint ETH Zurich/PSI research center
- Collaborate closely with a parallel PhD student in the Locher lab on glycoengineering
- Access state-of-the-art research infrastructure at one of Switzerland's leading institutions
- Strong mentoring, professional development, and international training opportunities

🏙️ Location Highlight
Zurich offers a world-leading scientific ecosystem at ETH Zurich, combined with a high quality of life at the heart of Europe.

🔗 More Info
https://t.co/sjoB0RPiyh
